notes: All figures from the 2025 Annual Report on HKEXnews (published April 28, 2026). Two employee bases overlap and are kept under separate metrics: the MD&A says 53,901 full-time employees were in the Chinese Mainland, while the ESG table counts 54,122 in 'Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan' (the report names these four, so that region carries a country list). The 2025 report no longer names India as the main location outside the Chinese Mainland, and the ESG table renamed its regions (Europe, North America, South America, Oceania); Oceania shows 4 and Africa 0 (omitted). The store count is 'approximately 18,000' Xiaomi stores in the Chinese Mainland as of December 2025; the roughly 450 overseas stores across 23 markets are not mapped because no country split is given. Sites: the Beijing headquarters is re-sourced to the 2025 report; the Changping smartphone factory and the Wuhan smart home appliance factory keep their 2024 Annual Report sources, because the 2025 report mentions both factories but not their locations. The Xiaomi EV Factory is described without a location, so it is not listed as a site. No U.S. state data.
